Summary: The commit fixes bug Be14f271da8 by deriving pipeline membership in `_guarded_human_gates` from every `GatesConfig` field whose name ends in `_pipeline` (via `dataclasses.fields`) instead of hardcoding `task_pipeline` and `phase_pipeline`. This makes the "refuse an edit that removes a human-approval gate from a pipeline" guard cover `promotion_pipeline`, where the `promotion_pipeline` doc tells operators to place a deploy sign-off. It adds four regression tests covering the MCP path, the CLI path, a still-valid promotion edit, and the unchanged task-pipeline behavior.

Both `_write_config` (:427) and `_append_config` (:491) call sites benefit. The tests use non-vacuous assertions (they check the refusal message and that the gate survives on disk).

No issues found.

data.summary: services/gates.py inert_requirements (~line 669) computes pipelines = task_pipeline | phase_pipeline, ignoring promotion_pipeline (which pipeline_for uses for promotions). With flow.environments set and a human gate deploy_signoff in promotion_pipeline, 'ddflow config --set gates.required [..., deploy_signoff]' is REFUSED: 'deploy_signoff is required but is in neither pipeline'. Probe: init; append [gate.deploy_signoff] human=true; set gates.promotion_pipeline [unit_tests,deploy_signoff,merge]; set flow.environments [staging]; set gates.required incl deploy_signoff -> refused. Similar task|phase-only sites: workflow.py:210 (gate with no command/prompt check) and workflow.py:304 (workflow view). Found while fixing Be14f271da8.
data.title: gates.required treats a promotion-only gate as inert, so a deploy sign-off cannot be made required

data.body:
Fixes bug B7f0b7c8839: services/gates.py inert_requirements (~line 669) computes pipelines = task_pipeline | phase_pipeline, ignoring promotion_pipeline (which pipeline_for uses for promotions). With flow.environments set and a human gate deploy_signoff in promotion_pipeline, 'ddflow config --set gates.required [..., deploy_signoff]' is REFUSED: 'deploy_signoff is required but is in neither pipeline'. Probe: init; append [gate.deploy_signoff] human=true; set gates.promotion_pipeline [unit_tests,deploy_signoff,merge]; set flow.environments [staging]; set gates.required incl deploy_signoff -> refused. Similar task|phase-only sites: workflow.py:210 (gate with no command/prompt check) and workflow.py:304 (workflow view). Found while fixing Be14f271da8.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B7f0b7c8839 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B7f0b7c8839 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B7f0b7c8839: gates.required treats a promotion-only gate as inert, so a deploy sign-off cannot be made required
